thag7.5:1.1: Sare hatthehi bhañjitvā katvāna kuṭim acchisaṃ, tena me Sarabhaṅgo 'ti nāmaṃ sammutiyā ahū. || ||
thag7.5:2.1: na mayhaṃ kappate ajja sare hatthehi bhañjituṃ, sikkhāpadā no paññattā Gotamena yasassinā. || ||
thag7.5:3.1: sakalaṃ samattaṃ rogaṃ Sarabhaṅgo nāddasaṃ pubbe, so 'yaṃ rogo diṭṭho vacanakarenātidevassa. || ||
thag7.5:4.1: yen' eva maggena gato Vipassī yen' eva maggena Sikhī ca Vessabhū Kakusandhakoṇāgamano ca Kassapo ten' añjasena agamāsi Gotamo. || ||
thag7.5:5.1: vītataṇhā anādānā satta buddhā khayogadhā, yeh' ayaṃ desito dhammo dhamabhūtehi tādihi || ||
thag7.5:6.1: cattāri ariyasaccāni anukampāya pāṇinaṃ, dukkhaṃ samudayo maggo nirodho dukkhasaṃkhayo. || ||
thag7.5:7.1: yasmiṃ nibbattate dukkhaṃ saṃsārasmiṃ anantakaṃ bhedā imassa kāyassa jīvitassa ca saṃkhayā añño punabbavo n' atthi, suvimutto 'mhi sabbadhīti. || || Sarabhaṅgo thero. uddānaṃ: Sundarasamuddo
thag7.5:8.0: thero thero Lakuṇṭabhaddiyo Bhaddo thero ca Sopāko Sarabhaṅgo mahā isi: Sattake pañcakā therā, gāthāyo pañcatiṃsatīti.
